notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.notes:
We are happy to release version 2.0 today.

In this update we have added new levels and Spells to the game.

Note: Do to a bug the in Game Achievements are not working we are working to fix this and an update will be out soon. 


Thanks

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes: We would like to thank everyone who bought Tower Blitz and we wanted to let you know we are working on a new version.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
We are just adding a few more things and doing our final testing in the next day or so then we will release the game for steam to review and publish to the store for sale. We look forward to you playing our game.

Thanks the GXPlay Team
